en: A black‑and‑white postcard view over a European spa town with a river or canal running through the middle, crossed by several small bridges. Tree‑lined streets and historic multi‑story buildings with ornate facades flank the waterway. In the foreground there are tram tracks, overhead wires, a tram stop shelter, and a few pedestrians. Hilly, wooded terrain with villas rises in the background. Printed caption text at the bottom reads: "BADEN-BADEN. Blick vom Bayrischen Hof".
